qualifiedVerdicts.content: Blind facet-split reviews on the shared initial commit and serialized fix rechecks found the original correctness, comprehensibility and scoped-coverage defects resolved. 通じる restores the source qualification that 通る does not replace every communication use; 輪 drops an unsupported frequency claim; 近代 is titled «эпоха модернизации», dates Meiji (1868) and qualifies the attested «новое время» translation against the Russian general-history periodization; 辺り and 迷惑 now demonstrate their contrasts with 近く/周り/近所/辺 and 面倒/手間/苦労; 丸 explains 円（えん）and its まる spelling. Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, Russian dictionary and periodization evidence, reconciliation, the preserved author/reviewer required-versus-conservative exclusion classification and process notes are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.
qualifiedVerdicts.fallbackAndVoice: Tag/random fallback options, voice/reading prompts and drawing not cleared.
qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: All 25 EN exclusions are retained. The reviewed RU title overlaps received 26 direct, one-sided exclusions: 迷惑–不便/厄介; 現代–現在/時代; 近代–時代; 瞬間–際; 迎え–迎える/会/会合; 農業–産業 under the generic-label rule; 農家–家族/家庭/家; 迷子–子/子供; 輪–指輪; 転ぶ–落ちる; 身長–成長/増加; 身–肉/中心; 辺り–頃/側/隣; 通す–極める; 轢く–移る. After review, 轢く–引っ越す was withdrawn because the 引っ越す title already disambiguates, and 近代 was retitled «эпоха модернизации», which is unique in the pool. Android applies each declaration symmetrically, so no reverse declarations were added to baseline cards.

Thirteen written kanji have no RU kanji card: 瞬, 端, 逆, 惑, 述, 辺, 農, 轢, 輪, 軒, 軍, 隊, 身.
